capabilities: Smooths scroll-wheel zoom with eased exponential scaling at the cursor
Pans with a captive middle-mouse cursor locked to the canvas
Zooms via middle-button drag or Ctrl combinations
Maps Wacom pinch, pen-tip and side-button gestures to zoom and pan
Exposes every tuning constant as a settings slider with number box and reset
disambiguation: Not a drawing or canvas plugin of its own; it only changes zoom and pan input behaviour inside the Excalidraw plugin.
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); no build step since main.js is the source, so toggling the plugin off and on reloads edits.
intentEvidence: Changes mouse scroll wheel behaviour to smoothly zoom in & out of the canvas.
problem: Excalidraw's default scroll-wheel zoom is abrupt, and Wacom pen-tablet users lack pinch, pen or side-button zoom and pan controls.

relations.evidence: The Excalidraw community plugin must be installed.

summary: Excalidraw input tweak that swaps scroll-wheel zoom for smooth eased zooming, adds captive-cursor panning and Wacom pen and touch controls.
